name: phase c final independent Lexi pilot

cases.task: resume Lexi current production audit and runtime modernization state and next steps
v1_context: Lexi should be presented as a deployed production-facing alpha/prototype, not production-ready, until the production audit blockers are fixed.

Current Lexi production audit blockers include public /lexi/readyz 503, disabled avatar_edit/img2img, divergent backend source trees, repo-root pytest import failure, telemetry/logging claim mismatch, streaming sanitizer NameError, and alpha session memory not recording /process.
Lex Phase 6 hardened runtime preflight with writable-path enforcement, bounded summarizer fallback behavior, and FastAPI lifespan startup handling.
Phase 6 runtime resilience checkpoint committed on top of the Phase 1-5 baseline, with generated eval/avatar files intentionally left uncommitted.

Lex modernization phases 1-5 checkpointed with validated auth/prompt/eval hardening, route uniqueness, eval runner, frontend build, backend startup smoke, auth/session, Google CSRF behavior, and prompt trust-boundary probes.
Lex modernization phases 2A-4 added Google CSRF double-submit checks, trusted-proxy IP resolution, untrusted-context prompt framing, route inventory, and machine-graded eval cases.
DreamerV2 persistent sidecar still collects fresh episodes but current learning is near replay-gated saturation because replay minlen: 10 skips short episodes.

expected_needs.description: Agent knows Lexi is alpha/prototype and not production-ready until blockers are fixed.
Agent knows the current production-audit blocker categories.
Agent knows the latest Lexi phase is runtime resilience work, including runtime preflight and startup lifecycle handling.
Agent knows the prior modernization baseline and validation gates that Phase 6 built on.
Agent knows Lexi's auth and prompt-trust boundary hardening work.
Agent knows the DreamerV2 sidecar is active but currently limited by replay gating rather than total inactivity.
Agent knows generated runtime artifacts should remain uncommitted.
